description: Projects selected by the platform's research team based on fundamentals, technical activity, and ecosystem positioning.

watchlist.name: Render Network
watchlist.thesis: Dominant decentralized GPU network. Apple Vision Pro pipeline expands TAM significantly. Real revenue, real customers.

watchlist.name: Bittensor
watchlist.thesis: Best-in-class AI compute coordination layer. Subnet thesis is now demonstrably working. dTAO is a structural improvement.

watchlist.name: Injective
watchlist.thesis: EVM compatibility opens institutional DeFi demand. iAgent is shipping. Real on-chain orderbook volume.

watchlist.name: Akash Network
watchlist.thesis: Open-source cloud compute stack. H100/A100 inference tier positions it as a hyperscaler alternative for AI startups.

watchlist.name: Ondo Finance
watchlist.thesis: Institutional RWA distribution. BlackRock BUIDL partnership is the most credible TradFi-crypto bridge to date.

watchlist.name: Filecoin
watchlist.thesis: Storage utilization inflection. New data-cap model fixes historical incentives. Defensible market position.

watchlist.name: Near Protocol
watchlist.thesis: AI-first L1 with credible sharding roadmap. Strong developer mindshare. Account abstraction is real adoption.

watchlist.name: Fetch.ai
watchlist.thesis: Agent economy narrative. ASI Alliance partnership adds distribution. Agent launchpad is a useful primitive.

watchlist.name: Arweave
watchlist.thesis: Permanent storage with the only credible long-term data model. AO compute layer is real adoption velocity.

watchlist.name: io.net
watchlist.thesis: Largest distributed GPU cluster. Strong product-market fit for ML inference workloads.

watchlist.name: Helium
watchlist.thesis: Real wireless subscribers, real cash flow. Mobile business unit now profitable. IoT narrative still early.

watchlist.name: aixbt by Virtuals
watchlist.thesis: AI agent with real mindshare and engagement. Demonstrates the agent economy product-market fit.

watchlist.name: Manta Pacific
watchlist.thesis: AI-focused modular L2. celestia DA keeps unit economics positive. Adoption steady but not exponential.

watchlist.name: Celestia
watchlist.thesis: Modular DA thesis intact. But adoption velocity below expectations. Long-term position, short-term cautious.
